title: Chat: disputed gpt-oss answers (owner's marks)
intro: Every gpt-oss answer where graders A, B and GPT don't all agree, from two runs on the fresh set of 50 questions: the control (today's live setup) and the best setup (search fix + claim filter). f08 of the best run is included too, where all three say wrong. Mark each Right or Wrong; your marks decide. Marks stay in this browser until you press Export marks, which saves a JSON file to send back.
